assertion.value: Gisbert Schneider is a scientific consultant to the pharmaceutical industry and a co-founder of AlloCyte Pharmaceuticals. Robert E. W. Hancock has co-founded two companies that are developing antimicrobial or innate defence regulator peptides for commercial use: Micrologix/Migenix (renamed BioWest Therapeutics) and Inimex Pharmaceuticals. In addition, he is currently pursuing commercialization opportunities with his newer peptides. His work is the subject of more than three dozen patents covering these peptides.
